name: Summer Research Academies (UCSB Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: Pick a research track in STEM, humanities or social sciences, take a 4-unit university course, develop a research topic with an instructor, and present your findings at a capstone seminar.
who_can_apply: High school students in 9th, 10th or 11th grade with a weighted GPA of at least 3.60. Students must attend the whole program and cannot take other courses or programs at the same time. No English test is needed for international applicants.
pay_detail: 2026 cost page (the 2027 price is not posted): commuter $3,475 total ($75 application fee + $900 deposit + $3,400 tuition and program fees); residential $9,874 total (adds $6,399 housing and meals). A limited number of need-based scholarships exist, with priority for California residents.
deadline_text: Application window Dec 15, 2026 to Mar 22, 2027. Reviews start in January and decisions are rolling.
how_to_apply: Online application with a transcript that includes fall 2026 grades, a 500-word personal statement, short answers, and the $75 fee. Tick the box on the application if you want to be considered for a scholarship. An optional info webinar is offered.
notes: Costs shown are the 2026 figures because the 2027 cost page was not updated. The younger, shorter and cheaper of the two UCSB pre-college programs. Contact: precollege@summer.ucsb.edu.
